description: Two-step file upload: requests an upload URL from Statuser, PUTs the local file there, and returns the public `file_url` you can pass into `incident_comment_create` / `incident_comment_update` as an attachment. Size limit: 5 MB.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

local_path.description: Absolute path to a local file.

name: incident_comment_upload_file
title: Upload a file to attach to a comment
